objects.name: Analytic 2045
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies an Industrial Control System (ICS) protocol message arriving at a device from a source whose identity is not in the approved communication baseline for that destination, where the message is structurally valid but originates outside the documented set of legitimate communicators. This technique-level analytic synthesizes Command Message (T1692.001) and Reporting Message (T1692.002). OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
